name: Discontent
overview: Scripture reveals that discontent arises when our hearts are set on earthly wealth and possessions, which ultimately fail to satisfy, as Ecclesiastes warns that loving silver and abundance is vanity. Jesus teaches that divided loyalties between God and mammon are impossible, urging believers to seek first God's kingdom and righteousness, promising that all other needs will be provided. Contentment is encouraged even in modest circumstances, as seen in Luke's instruction to be satisfied with one's wages. True fulfillment comes from delighting in the Lord, who grants the desires of the heart, and from trusting in the heavenly Father who generously gives the Holy Spirit to those who ask.
